failure_summary.description: Agents repeated completed searches, touched unrelated cached domains, added an unrequested domain, or used proximity instead of the requested location filter.
Result calls were left unsaved, nested inside save calls, or replaced a required cached-result filter with a fresh search.
Agents reformatted user-provided dates or incorrectly used trip dates as flight arrival-date constraints.
An explicit hotel amenity was omitted while a vague family-friendly preference was mapped to an unrequested amenity.

patch.reasoning: The recurring failures are already directly covered by the skill: preserve user date strings, search round-trip legs using each leg's departure date, avoid extra work on satisfied or unrelated domains, and assign and save each result exactly once. Amenity rules also already distinguish explicit criteria from inferred preferences. These are adherence failures rather than an uncovered skill gap, so additional guidance would duplicate existing rules.
